verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms AgentMail serves an llms.txt (HTTP 200) at docs.agentmail.to, with docs also published as .md pages. Agent-oriented docs reinforce this: an agent-driven quickstart where the agent registers itself, a blueprint feature that returns a prompt for coding agents, and installable agent skills. Missing for 10: independent or community hands-on reports of agents actually consuming the llms.txt/docs successfully, and evidence of a fuller LLM-oriented bundle (e.g., llms-full.txt).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Describe what you are working on and get a blueprint back, with a prompt your coding agent can build from.
The agent registers itself using an email you provide and receives an API key in response.
This works with Claude Code, Cursor, OpenClaw, Codex, and other compatible agents: npx skills add agentmail-to/agentmail-skills
